title: H.264, H.265: Simplify exponential Golomb coding, fix length
description:
Fix the number of bytes highlighted in the packet bytes for
exponential Golomb coding that is more than one byte.

Reduce code duplication by handing the 0 value code in the same
codepath as the others.
